name: Palmi (Italy)
description: Maroon field charged at the centre with the full achievement of the municipal arms of Palmi (a palm tree on blue, crowned, with crossed flags, cannon and a Turkish figure).
history: Municipal flag of Palmi, a comune in Calabria; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office. The arms were recognised by decree of the Head of Government on 9 March 1935.

features.role: Palmi arms — palm tree on blue, crowned, with crossed flags, cannon and trophies
